verdict.rationale: Asking a business-filing registry to publish third-party filer rules is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no published authorization forms, delegate roles, or rules on which signatures must stay personal. The closest items are an online account that can process filings for multiple entities and a link to tax-professional resources on the separate Revenue site, and both are adjacent rather than a documented delegation policy.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
